verdict.rationale: Orama documents itself as an open-source library for adding 'fast, relevant search' that can be imported directly in a browser module, and it lists full-text search with typo tolerance. Together these offer thin, indirect support for instant client-side search, but nothing in the pack shows as-you-type or keystroke-level search. Missing for 10: any documented prefix or as-you-type search behavior, any concrete millisecond latency claims or benchmarks, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of per-keystroke response times.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deliver as-you-type instant search with millisecond responses so results update on every keystroke

citations.quote: Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.
Or import it directly in a browser module
